text:
```yaml
name: Install Script Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    
    - name: Setup Dart
      uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
      with:
        sdk: stable
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        dart pub get
    
    - name: Format check
      run: |
        dart format -o none lib/src/workflows/update_project_references.workflow.dart || echo "Format check failed - this is expected in some environments"
    
    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        dart test
```
